name: Embodied Arena HILO
description: Vendor-neutral robot benchmark and HILO Realtime Protocol knowledge surface.

safety.mutationScope: Only authenticated private benchmark records at /studio/mcp. The public /mcp endpoint remains read-only.
safety.boundary: Agent outputs are informational or proposed actions. Physical execution requires a separate authenticated safety kernel.

studio.authentication: Manually configured Authorization: Bearer agent API key, created by the workspace owner in Studio. No OAuth discovery.
studio.dataNotice: User benchmarks are private, self-reported or illustrative, and not independently verified. Updates and deletions require the current record version.

dataNotice: Leaderboard seed scores are illustrative public-beta values, not deployment certifications. GPT-Realtime-2.1 is a reference implementation, not the benchmark.
